data.description:
## Description

**What**: Create tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh exercising each freshness predicate against a fixture project. Four cases: (a) all artifacts fresh -> all phases noop; (b) workflow-config.yaml modified -> only generate-claude-md executes; (c) project-understanding.md deleted -> dialogue + architect-foundation execute, init and generate-claude-md noop; (d) CLAUDE.md deleted -> only generate-claude-md executes. Each case asserts on the phase-invocation log artifact at \${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/onboarding-phases.log per the schema defined in S0.

**Why**: TDD discipline. The contract (S0) defines the behavior; this story makes it executable. Implementation (S2) cannot proceed until these tests exist and are confirmed RED.

**Scope**:
- IN: tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh; fixture-project setup helper; assertions against phase-invocation log JSONL per S0's schema. Test must run via the project's test runner and be confirmed FAILING (RED) before S2 begins.
- OUT: Test for SUB-AGENT-GUARD (S6). Unit tests for individual freshness predicates (deferred to S2's /dso:implementation-plan).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh exists with all four fixture cases covering SC1, SC2, SC3, and the CLAUDE.md-deleted case
  ← Satisfies: "A behavioral test at tests/scripts/test-onboarding-resume.sh exercises each freshness predicate against a fixture project across four cases ... Test asserts on the phase-invocation log artifact and passes in CI."
- When this story is complete, all four cases run and FAIL (RED) — failing run output is recorded as a ticket comment via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <story-id> 'RED confirmed: <test output summary>'`
  ← Satisfies: TDD RED phase precondition for S2.

## Considerations

- [Testing] Fixture setup must be hermetic — each case starts from a known artifact-state to make the predicate's behavior deterministic.
- [Reliability] Assertions against phase-invocation log fields (phase_name, invocation_reason, outcome) must reference the schema in S0 by name; do not duplicate the schema in test code.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer, failing E2E tests for /dso:onboarding's resume behavior exist (RED) before any orchestrator implementation begins
